waves.name: Nightly batch job, whole tree
waves.rationale: One entry point runs one program that calls one leaf. No dataset, no scheduler edge, no shared data, no cycle, so the family is a sound wave: it deploys and rolls back as one job. It is the only wave the tree supports. Whether it is the whole nightly cycle is not shown by the tree.
waves.unblocks: Nothing else in the tree depends on it. On this evidence it is a chore that proves the toolchain and the harness. It unblocks more only if the real nightly cycle holds jobs this tree omits.
